bull.b: The long-term Anthropic lease provides substantial contracted demand and improves revenue visibility as Justified is built. Google’s credit support strengthens the financing framework, potentially helping TeraWulf convert customer commitments into durable infrastructure cash flow.

Rapid growth in HPC lease revenue indicates that TeraWulf is progressing beyond bitcoin mining toward contracted data-center infrastructure. Increasing lease contribution can diversify revenue, improve utilization of developed capacity, and support a more durable business model.

The reported liquidity base gives TeraWulf meaningful resources to fund remaining Lake Mariner and Justified commitments without immediately relying on equity markets. This supports project continuity and provides flexibility while contracted capacity is brought online.

bear.b: Strong gross profitability has not translated into sustainable earnings because operating and other expenses overwhelm the revenue base. Persistent, exceptionally large losses weaken internal funding capacity and make future growth more dependent on financing and successful project execution.

The remaining Wolfe Compute investment represents a substantial obligation before the project is fully delivered and generating its expected economics. Large committed capital needs can constrain flexibility, increase financing dependence, and amplify execution risk if costs or timelines change.

Muskie’s planned expansion depends on converting customer interest into signed leases, yet timing and counterparties remain unresolved. Until commitments are secured, the associated power and development roadmap carries greater utilization, financing, and execution uncertainty than contracted projects.
